name: catalogs
description: A user-defined typed collection, such as products, a menu or a weekly agenda, owned by a company or one branch.
lifecycle: Created with an empty schema. Renames, archiving, restoring and schema saves bump the version; schema saves also bump the schema version. Deleted at runtime only when it has no records and no other catalog's reference field targets it. The owning scope never changes. See docs/project/catalog-composition-design.md.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the catalog; immutable (tenant key).
Branch that owns the catalog; immutable.
columns.Null meaning: The catalog belongs to the whole company and every member who may view catalogs sees it.

columns.Meaning: Display name chosen by members, trimmed, 1 to 120 characters.
Optimistic concurrency version of the catalog and its schema, starting at 1.
Counts schema saves, starting at 1, so published snapshots can name the schema they copied.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change to the catalog row.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The owning branch belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A catalog belongs to an existing company.
Names are trimmed and not empty.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX catalogs_company_created_idx ON public.catalogs USING btree (company_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Lists a company's catalogs newest first with keyset cursors.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalogs_company_id_id_key ON public.catalogs USING btree (company_id, id)
